sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT ?campaign ?campaignNumber (COUNT(DISTINCT ?make) AS ?brandCount) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?makeName; separator=", ") AS ?brands)
WHERE {
  ?campaign rc:campaignNumber ?campaignNumber ;
            rc:affects ?variant .
  ?variant rc:ofModel ?model .
  ?model rc:ofMake ?make .
  ?make rc:name ?makeName .
  FILTER(UCASE(STR(?makeName)) IN ("HYUNDAI", "KIA", "GENESIS"))
}
GROUP BY ?campaign ?campaignNumber
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?make) > 1)
ORDER BY DESC(?brandCount) ?campaignNumber

SELECT ?modelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?campaign) AS ?campaignCount) WHERE { ?campaign rc:affects ?variant . ?variant rc:ofModel ?model . ?model rc:name ?modelName . } GROUP BY ?modelName ORDER BY DESC(?campaignCount) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?campaign) AS ?odiCampaigns) WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?initiator . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?initiator), "ODI|Defects Investigation", "i")) }
